b_01KXB28HKEA5X2H76K4M8SRXAB.subject: tdec_timeline_risk
b_01KXB28HKEA5X2H76K4M8SRXAB.content: With a scheduled start of 2026-10-05 (85 days out) and TDEC septic review requiring a 70-day minimum lead time, the septic permit process must be initiated immediately or the October 5 start date is at risk. There is no evidence TDEC contact has been made.
b_01KXB28HKEA5X2H76K4M8SRXAB.falsification_test: Evidence that TDEC contact has already been initiated, or that the existing septic system has been pre-verified as sufficient, would falsify this.

b_01KXB28HKE5J65YXEHND9WQCYQ.subject: retrofit_section_separation
b_01KXB28HKE5J65YXEHND9WQCYQ.content: The 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' section is a retrofit component that must be tracked and scheduled independently from new-construction tasks; its negative material cost requires owner review before the breakdown is used to set contract pricing.
b_01KXB28HKE5J65YXEHND9WQCYQ.falsification_test: Owner confirmation that the negative cost is an intentional salvage credit and the breakdown is approved for contract use would falsify the 'requires review' element.
